footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 17.9% to $1.4B in 2025. Gross margin was 20.2%, versus 19.9% a year earlier, and operating income was $72.7M, up from a $62.9M loss.
Net income was $49.2M, or $0.78 per share, after a $110M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $100M and free cash flow $86.8M, versus $43.2M.
watch: Cost of revenue is 80% of revenue.
